events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman and solo artist, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam 54th Birthday
angles.copy: Parka on, attitude dialled to eleven. Wishing a very happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine', featuring his iconic title track, was released on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine' a better world. A timeless message that resonates just as powerfully today.

events.title: The first Apple iPod was unveiled 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on October 23, 2001, promising "1,000 songs in your pocket" and revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Before streaming, before smartphones, there was the iPod. Twenty-five years since Apple dropped this game-changer, putting a thousand songs in our pockets.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on October 5, 1962, marking over six decades of the iconic spy.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab a martini (shaken, not stirred) and celebrate Global James Bond Day! Six decades since 007 first hit the big screen.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician, songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that still sparks debate.

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true showman. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul' – a pivotal album that pushed their sound into new, innovative territory.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Musician and peace activist John Lennon tragically passed away on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music endures.
